methodology_note: The review's grading model is accurate against the v1.0.1 snapshot. Every bullet reproduced, with two refinements the findings should carry: the discoverable-tool log is keyed by tool name only (one call with any arguments satisfies a gold read, and repeats are no-ops), and call_discoverable_agent_tool skips logging on TypeError, unknown or not-unlocked tools. Replay-based testing of hash divergence was used well and every replay claim I re-ran held. The main weakness is reasoning that is not cross-checked against other tasks: the 080/081 Major rests on an arithmetic slip that the benchmark's own convention in 039-041 contradicts, and 097's Blocker treats a weakly supported omission as unsupported while 094/095 rate the same component Major. Cross-task defect classes (liability anchor, discretionary provisional credit, card-design defaults, 0.025% bonus, unlock-by-reset) are scattered across per-task files and would be clearer as shared findings with one severity. The false-negative audit of task_089 found no missed defect.
